name: Anah
bio: Anah, a son of Zibeon the Hivite and father of Aholibamah, one of Esau's wives, was later counted among the Horite clan chiefs of Seir; he was the one who discovered the hot springs (or mules, by another reading) in the wilderness while pasturing his father's donkeys (Genesis 36:2, 14, 20, 24-25, 29).
